basic_profile.bio: Based in Vancouver, I am a 27-year-old freelance game developer with a passion for RPGs and multiplayer games. I've been an avid gamer since childhood, and I love discussing game mechanics and design elements. I spend most of my nights online due to my flexible work schedule, often diving into the world of Genshin Impact or exploring new indie games. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to dive deeply into my hobbies. I'm a big fan of late-night gaming sessions with friends, and I have a particular dislike for poor game optimization and loading issues.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science with a focus on game development. Over the years, I've self-taught various programming languages and game design principles through online courses and community forums. My professional experience includes working on indie game projects and collaborating with small teams to produce engaging gameplay experiences.
